PINNACLEAI® · THE COMPLETE STORY

Built around
the child’s life.

Share this pageWhatsApp

A life-first purpose. A documented Indian medical-device foundation. A new chapter in international readiness.

PinnacleAI® brings developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support into the child’s journey—with families and professionals at its heart.

Source-linked editorial review · 24 September 2026

For familiesPurpose & everyday life For clinicians & researchersFunctions, studies & methods For international partnersLicensing & export documents

PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 is Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software for children aged 0–12. The licence holder and legal manufacturer is Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. Pinnacle Blooms Network is the child-development brand and service ecosystem.

Read the licensed intended use · Explore the organisation’s identity

THE PURPOSE

The outcome belongs at the beginning.

Section link

A self-sufficient, mainstream and wonderful life for the child determines the abilities, goals, methods, people, practice and review.

That means beginning with the life a child is working toward: communicating, learning, making choices, joining in, building confidence and becoming increasingly independent. A score can inform the next step; the child’s life gives that step its purpose.

THE SEVEN-STAGE PATHWAY

From capability to participation.

Section link

The pathway connects professional support with practice at home and review over time. Goals and pace remain individual to each child.

  1. 01

    Identify capabilities and measure ability

  2. 02

    Forecast readiness and create a child-specific plan

  3. 03

    Provide integrated therapies and intervention

  4. 04

    Support parent-guided everyday practice and home generalisation

  5. 05

    Track progress and correct the plan

  6. 06

    Reassess and repeat until readiness

  7. 07

    Support growing independence, school readiness and mainstream participation

THE SOFTWARE’S ROLE

Support the people supporting the child.

Section link

The manufacturing licence names four intended functions. These support measurement, planning and review by the people involved in the child’s development.

Developmental ability measurement

Organise observations of a child’s abilities so the starting point and goals can be discussed.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image

Readiness tracking

Follow readiness for participation and everyday goals through repeated review.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image

Progress forecasting

Support planning with forecasts that are considered alongside professional judgement.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image

Adaptive therapy-plan support

Support review and adjustment of the child-specific plan as information changes.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image

People remain central. Parents, therapists, educators and caregivers are the intended users. The product is non-diagnostic; clinical and care decisions remain within appropriate human and professional review.

The BIS scope schedule names AbilityScore mapping, Prognose, Everyday Therapy through TherapeuticAI, and tracking and correction through Fusion. These names describe the documented software scope; each child’s goals and outcomes are individual.

23 SEPTEMBER 2026 · THE EXPORT MILESTONE

Export ready from India.

Section link

Free Sale Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 adds a documented export foundation to the licensed PinnacleAI product.

Issued by the State Licensing Authority, TG SAFE, Telangana, on 23 September 2026, the certificate references manufacturing licence MFG/MD/2026/000248. It records that the listed device may be manufactured and sold in India under Indian law and exported as per the law of the importing country.

For potential international partners, the practical value is an inspectable source package: product identity, intended use, manufacturer, licence, management-system scope and the export certificate. Market access then proceeds under each destination’s requirements.

Read the public certificate · Read the forwarding letter

Indian export documentation is established. A foreign registration or marketing authorisation is a separate, country-specific step.

QUESTIONS FROM FAMILIES AND PARTNERS

Questions, answered with context.

Section link
What is PinnacleAI®?

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 is identified in the supplied Indian manufacturing licence as Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software for children aged 0–12. Its stated functions include developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
Who is the legal manufacturer?

Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited is the licence holder and legal manufacturer named in the reviewed regulatory records. Pinnacle Blooms Network is the child-development brand and service ecosystem.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
What does the Free Sale Certificate establish?

FSC/MD/2026/000741 records Indian domestic marketability and export eligibility for the licensed device. It supports country-specific market-access applications; it is not approval or registration in another country.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
Does PinnacleAI® diagnose children?

No. The licensed product is described as non-diagnostic developmental-support software. Clinical and care decisions remain within the appropriate human and professional review process.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
Has PinnacleAI® been registered in other countries?

This page does not claim a foreign registration. Each market will be labelled researching, representative appointed, technical file prepared, submitted, under review or registered only when the corresponding evidence is available.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
How can the evidence be reused?

Use the citation downloads and machine-readable JSON or text exports. Cite the exact licence, certificate or dated report for a specific claim and retain its date and scope.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
What does “operating system” mean in the PinnacleAI story?

Pinnacle uses GPT-OS in its product name and describes an approach spanning measurement, planning, everyday practice and review. The regulatory description is non-diagnostic developmental-support software; “operating system” is not a separate regulatory approval category.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
What does the export milestone mean for my child?

The Free Sale Certificate documents the device’s regulatory standing in India and supports international market-access work. For your child, the useful questions remain the individual goals, the care team, everyday practice, progress review and the relevant centre’s records.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
Where can a family start?

Call Pinnacle’s National Autism Helpline on 9100 181 181 for free guidance, available 24/7. The service is operated by Pinnacle Blooms Network / Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. Free guidance is separate from assessment or therapy charges; normal call charges may apply.
